## Description {#details}

<p>The exact size encodable in "Fix" variants of formats.</p>


<p>The only objects for which an exact size makes sense are of <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/extension">Extension</a> type.</p>


<p>For example, FixExt4 stores an extension type containing exactly four bytes.</p>
